summary: Verified every claim in the issue and requirements against source (all hold, no premise conflict) and found three hazards neither document names — the naive fix would surface 'CLI returned error: unknown' and fail the name-the-real-cause criterion.

details.premise: confirmed — is_error appears exactly once in src/ (claude-code-agent.ts:188, on tool_result blocks); the result event's is_error is read nowhere. Both decision sites (:480 salvage, :508 clean-exit) gate on subtype alone. The need is not already satisfied elsewhere.
new_hazards_not_in_requirements: H1 (highest impact): Claude's result event has NO 'error' field — verified against the repo's own captured fixture, whose result-event keys are [type, subtype, is_error, result, total_cost_usd, session_id]. The real cause lives in 'result'. The existing :508 message template reads resultEvent['error'] ?? 'unknown', so routing is_error through it surfaces 'CLI returned error: unknown', silently destroying the cause and failing acceptance criterion #5 while the run still fails and still retries — a test asserting only throw+retry would pass.

H2: site :503 ('No result event found in CLI output', exit 0 + truncated stream) is a THIRD instance of the same defect class, created with no options so retryable defaults to false. A connection dropped before the result line lands here and is still treated as terminal. Not named in the acceptance criteria; design must make a deliberate call.

H3: tests/helpers/test-mock-pipeline.ts:208 fakeAgent is a bare object cast, not an AgentAdapter subclass, so it does NOT inherit run()'s error wrapping. Existing agent-step failure tests reject with plain Errors, hitting isRetryable's message heuristic — a path unreachable in production for anything thrown by a plugin. A regression test written that way would keep passing even if retryable:true were never set.
details.finding_5_strengthened: Requirements said the retry-before-readResult ordering is a cost regression but 'correctness holds'. Verified the ordering (retry loop at agent-step.ts:328-348 runs entirely before readResult at :111; resetResultFile runs once at :89). Correctness does NOT strictly hold: a retried attempt re-runs the same agent in the same directory and will overwrite the good session-result.json; if that attempt dies early or mid-write, readResult sees a template/malformed file and the run fails no_result. The naive fix can turn a run that passes today into one that fails — this makes the result-aware retry a correctness constraint, not just a cost one.
details.reuse: No shared transient classifier exists anywhere in src/. AdapterError.retryable IS the convention and all three plugins already set it (claude :494, gemini :453/:467, opencode :393/:406). Core consumes it generically and needs NO change to honor a retryable throw — the only forced Core change is the result-aware retry guard above.
details.test_gaps: The agent contract suite (tests/helpers/contract-suites/agent-contract.ts, run by 4 plugins) has ZERO failure-semantics assertions. MAX_AGENT_RETRIES / isRetryable / sleep appear in zero test files — the retry loop this fix depends on has never itself been verified to work.
details.unverified: I have not observed the raw Claude event for an auth failure or max_turns stop; the transient-vs-terminal classifier should fail safe (an unrecognized is_error is still a failure; defaulting unknown errors to non-retryable preserves today's escalate-to-owner behavior).
